text:
No single product I found does all three well. A wireless 3-in-1 stand covers the phone and watch but not the laptop. A power hub covers the laptop but has no watch pad. Here are the best options.

## Best for laptop + phone + watch from one outlet: Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 (140 W)
- One 140 W USB-C port (enough for a 16-inch MacBook Pro), a built-in retractable 100 W cable, two more ports, and a certified Qi2 pad that charges iPhone 13-16 at 15 W.
- It has no dedicated watch pad. You'd plug your watch's own charger into a spare port, which is my inference from the port list.
- Only the main USB-C port reaches 140 W. The retractable cable and second USB-C top out at 100 W, and USB-A at 15 W.
- Price is $149.99 at Baseus's US store, but it was **sold out when checked on Oct 21**, so confirm stock first.
- [Product page and buy link](https://dealectric.com/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2). It's an affiliate link, and the page says it costs you nothing extra.

## Best if you want a clean wireless phone + watch + earbuds stand
- **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand** is WIRED's best overall. It charges an iPhone at up to 15 W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods case sits on the base, and the list price is $109 (around $80-98 at retailers). It has no extra ports, so your laptop needs its own charger. [WIRED's guide with shop links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 Charging Station** is a cheaper alternative with 15 W Qi2 for the phone. It lists at $89.99 and is often around $67-70. It folds flat for travel. [StandDeskLab review with buy links](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/)
- **ESR Qi2 3-in-1** is the budget pick at about $40 on sale. [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Budget laptop option to pair with a stand
The Anker 341 USB-C Hub (about $40) passes through up to 100 W to a laptop and adds HDMI, an SD card slot, and extra ports. [StandDeskLab review](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/)

## My pick
- **Apple phone and watch, and you want one box:** Baseus Nomos, if it's back in stock.
- **Cleaner look, and your laptop already has a good charger:** the Belkin stand.

Which laptop do you have, and is your watch an Apple Watch? Laptop wattage matters for the hub, and Android watches don't work on these Apple-style pads. That would settle which one to buy.
